verdict.rationale: Kit's pricing page claims "Unlimited Visual Automations," which implies native event-triggered rules, but no documentation describes the triggers, conditions, or actions behind it. The documented event-driven path is webhooks (e.g. subscriber.unsubscribed, subscriber.bounced), signed deliveries with retries, but those only notify your own external code, which must then perform the actions. Missing for 10: documentation of native automation triggers/conditions/actions, API or MCP access to define rules, hands-on or independent corroboration.
